00043 PollUGenInternal::PollUGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& trig) throw()
00044 : UGenInternal(NumInputs)
00045 {
00046   inputs[Input] = input;
00047   inputs[Trig] = trig;
00048   lastTrig = 0.f;
00049 }
00050 
00051 UGenInternal* PollUGenInternal::getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00052 {
00053   PollUGenInternal* internal = new PollUGenInternal(inputs[Input].getChannel(channel),
00054                             inputs[Trig].getChannel(channel));
00055   internal->lastTrig = lastTrig;
00056   internal->receivers = receivers;
00057   return internal;
00058 }
00059 
00060 void PollUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00061 {
00062   const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00063   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00064   float* const trigSamples = inputs[Trig].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00065   
00066   for(int sample = 0; sample < numSamplesToProcess; sample++)
00067   {
00068     float thisTrig = trigSamples[sample];
00069     
00070     if(thisTrig > 0.f && lastTrig <= 0.f)
00071     {
00072       const int numChannels = inputs[Input].getNumChannels();
00073       Buffer poll = Buffer::newClear(numChannels);
00074       float * const pollSamples = poll.getData(0);
00075       
00076       for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00077       {
00078         float* const inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00079         pollSamples[channel] = inputSamples[sample];
00080       }
00081       
00082       sendBuffer(poll);
00083     }
00084     
00085     *outputSamples++ = 0.f;
00086     lastTrig = thisTrig;
00087   }
00088 }
00089 
00090 Poll::Poll(UGen const& input, UGen const& trig) throw()
00091 {
00092   initInternal(1);
00093   internalUGens[0] = new PollUGenInternal(input, trig.mix());
00094 }
